verdict.rationale: Gmail's delegation feature lets one or more delegates read, send, and delete mail in a shared account, so a team can work one mailbox and see the same messages. However, nothing in the evidence shows purpose-built shared-inbox collaboration such as assignment, collision detection, internal comments, or team channels. Missing for 10: team-channel or collaborative-inbox features, documented shared conversation-state tracking (who's handling or replied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation for team use.
